Hi team,

I want to align on how we're handling manager notes for this quarter's check-ins, particularly for the few cases that involve potential org changes and sensitive performance conversations. A couple of specific asks:

- Can we standardize a redaction workflow for notes that will be stored in Workday? HR prefers summaries in the employee record and separate sensitive write-ups stored in the manager-only folder.
- Laura/Vivek: please attach your manager notes template and a sample redacted note so Monica and I can validate.
- Monica: can you confirm the Workday ticketing and retention settings we should request? We may need a temporary access exception for the people ops partner.

I've attached the manager_notes_Q2-2027.docx template to use as the starting point. I don't want these threads to proliferate — let's keep any sensitive write-ups out of general distribution.

Goal: finalize routing & retention guidance by EOD Wednesday so managers can finish notes by Friday.

Thanks,
Soojin

Thanks — this is timely. A few clarifications from HR: 

1) Workday storage: HR will accept a short HR-facing summary (1–2 paragraphs) in the official employee record. Manager-only write-ups should be stored in a restricted "Manager Docs" Drive folder with explicit access grants.
2) Retention: default retention for manager-only docs is 24 months unless legal holds apply. We can set 18 months for these by request; please confirm per-item when you submit.
3) Approval/sign-off: HR will accept the manager's HR summary once the manager and skip-level manager sign off; for org-change proposals we need a Director-level concurrence (Soojin in this case) before submission to People Ops for processing.
4) Workday ticket: I've opened ticket #45321 to request a temporary access exception for PeopleOps Consulting and to configure retention flags. Ticket stub attached.

Action items:
- Managers: share final manager-only docs (in the Manager Docs folder) and the short HR summaries by Thursday COB.
- Soojin: please confirm if you approve the org-change draft; if you do, Monica will escalate processing.

Monica

Hi Vivek / team,

Thanks for the context — see attached a concise SOP and a small checklist we use at other orgs. High-level recommendations:

1) Replace names and obvious identifiers with standardized tokens (e.g., <EMP>, <MANAGER>).
2) Keep examples but remove verbatim quotes that could identify a person.
3) Keep separate version history for manager-only docs; only HR summaries go into Workday.
4) We can also run a quick automated PII scan against the Drive folder for you as a one-time engagement.

Cost note: automated scan + one-hour workshop = $1,200; if you're okay with that Monica can route procurement.

Attached: redaction_sop_peopleops_v1.pdf
